51	/****************************************************************************
52	 * uIP is a small implementation of the IP, UDP and TCP protocols (as
53	 * well as some basic ICMP stuff). The implementation couples the IP,
54	 * UDP, TCP and the application layers very tightly. To keep the size
55	 * of the compiled code down, this code frequently uses the goto
56	 * statement. While it would be possible to break the ipv4_input()
57	 * function into many smaller functions, this would increase the code
58	 * size because of the overhead of parameter passing and the fact that
59	 * the optimizer would not be as efficient.
60	 *
61	 * The principle is that we have a small buffer, called the d_buf,
62	 * in which the device driver puts an incoming packet. The TCP/IP
63	 * stack parses the headers in the packet, and calls the
64	 * application. If the remote host has sent data to the application,
65	 * this data is present in the d_buf and the application read the
66	 * data from there. It is up to the application to put this data into
67	 * a byte stream if needed. The application will not be fed with data
68	 * that is out of sequence.
69	 *
70	 * If the application wishes to send data to the peer, it should put
71	 * its data into the d_buf. The d_appdata pointer points to the
72	 * first available byte. The TCP/IP stack will calculate the
73	 * checksums, and fill in the necessary header fields and finally send
74	 * the packet back to the peer.
75	 *
76	 ****************************************************************************/

131	#ifdef CONFIG_DEBUG_FEATURES
132	static int ipv4_check_opt(FAR struct ipv4_hdr_s *ipv4)
133	{
134	  FAR uint8_t *opt = (FAR uint8_t *)(ipv4 + 1);
135	  int optlen;
136	
137	  optlen = ((ipv4->vhl & IPv4_HLMASK) << 2) - IPv4_HDRLEN;
138	  while (optlen > 0)
139	    {
140	      if (opt[0] == IPOPT_END_TYPE)
141	        {
142	          break;
143	        }
144	      else if (opt[0] == IPOPT_NOOP_TYPE)
145	        {
146	          opt++;
147	          optlen--;
148	        }
149	      else if (optlen > 1)
150	        {
151	          int len = opt[1];
152	          if (len > optlen)
153	            {
154	              return -EINVAL;
155	            }
156	
157	          opt += len;
158	          optlen -= len;
159	        }
160	      else
161	        {
162	          return -EINVAL;
163	        }
164	    }
165	
166	  return OK;
167	}

173	 * Description:
174	 *   Receive an IPv4 packet from the network device.  Verify and forward to
175	 *   L3 packet handling logic if the packet is destined for us.
176	 *
177	 *   This is the iob buffer version of ipv4_input(),
178	 *   this function will support send/receive iob vectors directly between
179	 *   the driver and l3/l4 stack to avoid unnecessary memory copies,
180	 *   especially on hardware that supports Scatter/gather, which can
181	 *   greatly improve performance
182	 *   this function will uses d_iob as packets input which used by some
183	 *   NICs such as celluler net driver.
184	 *
185	 * Input Parameters:
186	 *   dev   - The device on which the packet was received and which contains
187	 *           the IPv4 packet.
188	 *
189	 * Returned Value:
190	 *   OK    - The packet was processed (or dropped) and can be discarded.
191	 *   ERROR - Hold the packet and try again later.  There is a listening
192	 *           socket but no receive in place to catch the packet yet.  The
193	 *           device's d_len will be set to zero in this case as there is
194	 *           no outgoing data.
195	 *
196	 ****************************************************************************/

228	   *
229	   * Check validity of the IP header.

231	   * presences of IPv4 options.  The header length is encoded as a number
232	   * 32-bit words in the HL nibble of the VHL.
233	   */

235	  if ((ipv4->vhl & IP_VERSION_MASK) != 0x40 ||
236	      (ipv4->vhl & IPv4_HLMASK) < 5)
237	    {
238	      /* IP version and header length. */
239	
240	#ifdef CONFIG_NET_STATISTICS
241	      g_netstats.ipv4.drop++;
242	      g_netstats.ipv4.vhlerr++;
243	#endif
244	      nwarn("WARNING: Invalid IP version or header length: %02x\n",

247	    }

249	  /* Get the size of the packet minus the size of link layer header */
250	
251	  dev->d_len -= NET_LL_HDRLEN(dev);
252	
253	  if (((ipv4->vhl & IPv4_HLMASK) << 2) > dev->d_len)

255	      nwarn("WARNING: Packet shorter than IPv4 header\n");

257	    }

259	  /* Make sure that all packet processing logic knows that there is an IPv4

277	    }

282	#endif
283	      nwarn("WARNING: IP packet shorter than length in IP header\n");
284	      goto drop;
285	    }
286	
287	  /* Check the fragment flag. */
288	
289	  if ((ipv4->ipoffset[0] & 0x3f) != 0 || ipv4->ipoffset[1] != 0)
290	    {
291	#ifdef CONFIG_NET_IPFRAG
292	      if (ipv4_fragin(dev) == OK)
293	        {

295	        }
296	
297	#endif

301	#endif
302	      nwarn("WARNING: IP fragment dropped\n");
303	      goto drop;
304	    }
305	
306	#ifdef CONFIG_DEBUG_FEATURES
307	  if (ipv4_check_opt(ipv4) != OK)
308	    {
309	#ifdef CONFIG_NET_STATISTICS

311	#endif
312	      nwarn("WARNING: IP options error\n");
313	      goto drop;
314	    }
315	#endif
316

354	      /* Process the incoming packet if not forwardable */

356	      if (dev->d_len > 0)

358	        {

362	      goto done;
363	    }
364	  else

379	
380	      ipv4_forward_broadcast(dev, ipv4);
381	
382	      /* Process the incoming packet if not forwardable */
383	
384	      if (dev->d_len > 0)
385	#endif
386	        {
387	          ret = udp_ipv4_input(dev);
388	        }
389	
390	      goto done;
391	    }
392	  else
393	#endif
394	  /* Check if the packet is destined for our IP address. */
395	
396	  if (!net_ipv4addr_cmp(destipaddr, dev->d_ipaddr))
397	    {
398	      /* No.. This is not our IP address. Check for an IPv4 IGMP group

400	       */
401	
402	#ifdef CONFIG_NET_IGMP

410	
411	          /* Return success if the packet was forwarded. */
412	
413	          if (dev->d_len == 0)
414	            {
415	              goto done;
416	            }
417	#endif
418	        }
419	
420	#endif
421	      /* No.. The packet is not destined for us. */
422	
423	#ifdef CONFIG_NET_IPFORWARD

426	      if (!net_ipv4addr_cmp(dev->d_ipaddr, INADDR_ANY) &&

448	        {

451	           */
452	
453	          ninfo("WARNING: Not destined for us; not forwardable... "

456	#ifdef CONFIG_NET_STATISTICS

463

466	  else if (net_ipv4addr_cmp(dev->d_ipaddr, INADDR_ANY))
